items.item: User can search the web on demand and never in the background
User can send mail only after approving the draft
User can generate a draft document without losing an existing one
User can see exactly what left the machine and when
Stage gate: no outward action escapes its gate

bugs.title: Assistant claims it searched the web without any card or search (typo 'serch the web')
bugs.repro: Type 'serch the web for how to bake sourdough bread'; reply says 'I found a few good articles...' with no card. 3 of 4 tries.

bugs.title: Banner 'Nothing has been sent anywhere' stays after web search / email attempt
bugs.repro: Approve a web search; banner top-left unchanged.

bugs.title: Email draft ignores the requested subject, leaves [Your Name] placeholder, invents content
bugs.repro: Ask 'send an email to someone@example.com and other@example.com saying hello, subject Hi'; card shows Subject 'Hello Message', body 'Best regards, [Your Name] Thanks'.

bugs.title: Draft document invents content and ignores the user's own notes (45,000 dollars budget)
bugs.repro: Ask 'write a short report about the Orion project budget' in a folder whose notes.txt states the budget.

bugs.title: Asking what left the computer gives irrelevant or made-up answers with bogus sources (random.zip:1)
bugs.repro: Ask 'what has left my computer so far, and when?' and 'which websites did you search and what was sent?'

undesired.title: No view of outward actions (searches, emails) with time and content
undesired.detail: What changed says nothing changed outside ARTEMIS after a search and an email attempt; no such list in Settings, Folders or What it knows.

undesired.title: Approving an email with no account gives 'Nothing was changed. 1 step did not run' and no pointer to Settings
undesired.detail: Card warns, but Approve is still allowed.

undesired.title: Approval card sits below the buttons, far down the page
undesired.detail: Voice widgets push the card away from the buttons; card says 'buttons above'.

undesired.title: Search results shown raw with no note of service, query sent, or time
undesired.detail: Shown under an 'Approve' turn with no summary.

undesired.title: Inconsistent wording 'This would search' vs 'This will search'
Weather answer confusing and does not offer a gated web search
undesired.detail: 'search the web for general information like recipes or guides you give me access to'.

undesired.title: Stale 'Voice is on' message and Record widget after unticking voice
Stored-locally figure jumps by tens of MB; draft preview cut off in card
Draft saved as .md with markdown asterisks
